title: (Gp) for unrotated graph planes: two-sided Hilbert-Schmidt comparison near 0
statement: For all natural numbers n, l there is L_0 with 0 < L_0 <= 1/4 such that for all continuous linear A, B : R^n -> R^l with hsNorm A <= L_0 and hsNorm B <= L_0: hsNormSq (A - B) <= hsNormSq (Pi(A) - Pi(B)) <= 3 hsNormSq (A - B), where Pi(A) is the orthogonal projection (starProjection) of R^(n+l) onto span{graphPoint v (A v) : v in R^n}.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), ∃ L₀ : ℝ, 0 < L₀ ∧ L₀ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ ∀ (A B : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), hsNorm A ≤ L₀ → hsNorm B ≤ L₀ → hsNormSq (A - B) ≤ hsNormSq ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).starProjection - (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (B v))).starProjection) ∧ hsNormSq ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v))).starProjection - (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (B v))).starProjection) ≤ 3 * hsNormSq (A - B)
